info.title: SweetCommerce Customer and Merchant API
info.description: Remediated design draft. Timely event deposit proof preserves the slot (DEC-020); delayed verification adjusts effective balance deadline (DEC-021). Money uses MYR sen.

Set-Cookie.description: Secure HttpOnly opaque same-origin session cookie

post.description: Verify an admin-only challenge; never provision a new account.
Send only to the enrolled admin channel. Enrollment or recovery uses a controlled merchant procedure.

requestBody.description: At most 5 MiB. Complete validated registration, rather than upload start, adjudicates the deadline.

post.description: Late evidence on an owned expired or cancelled charge creates a merchant reconciliation case; it cannot reopen order, booking, or allocation.
Cash collection uses confirmReceipt, which records pickup and receipt together. No-show and Cash receipt are mutually exclusive.

NORMAL matches the exact expected balance. SUPPLEMENT binds the open mismatch case and posts one independently verified top-up; only a combined exact total on an eligible and feasible active order accepts once. RECONCILIATION records actual funds without reopening. For late event deposit verification under DEC-021 include lateDepositDecision; server checks deadline and records either the effective 24-hour window or reschedule/refund case.
Confirm an independently verified payout against the matching reserved refund intent. Use the actual movement reference and current charge version.

get.description: Maximum 92 local days inclusive. Money by actual movement, prep by fulfilment day, conversion by quote cohort. Merchant supplies off-platform counts separately.

post.description: Lock review; return the existing order if submitted, otherwise prevent every future submission of this review before a new intent may start.
Mark uncertain without releasing funds, or void only after verifying the payout did not occur. Confirmed payout uses recordRefund against this same intent.
Agreement must cover the revised promise. Use same allocation transaction to preserve original commitment if the change fails.
Create a separately tracked DuitNow charge only after recorded customer agreement to the fee. The accepted original order total remains unchanged.

outstandingMinor.description: Expected amount minus verified unapplied/refundable-adjusted receipts, clamped to zero. Server applies eligible settlement guards separately.

message.example: Review the current total and handoff before submitting.
